title: Acceptance Standards and Inspection Periods for New HomeGuard Policies
content:
A new HomeGuard Homeowners Policy is accepted on a package only when the applicant meets that package's entry gate, and every new policy is followed by an inspection whose kind and timing the package fixes. This guide lists both for all six packages.

## Entry gate by package

| Entry condition | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-occupied residence | required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Oldest roof age accepted at binding (years) | 20 | 20 | 22 | 20 | 22 | 25 |
| Oldest dwelling age accepted at binding, from year built (years) | 80 | 100 | 120 | 100 | 120 | 150 |
| Coverage A within the package's Coverage A range | required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Most non-weather paid claims in the last 36 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |

(Column headings shorten HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.)

The roof and dwelling age figures are maxima: a roof or dwelling exactly at the figure is accepted, and one a year older is not. The claims figure is likewise a maximum: HomeGuard HO-5 Signature accepts no applicant with a non-weather paid claim in the last 36 months, while every other package accepts at most one.

## Inspection and new business period terms

| Term | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| New-business inspection ordered on every new policy | exterior | exterior | exterior | exterior | exterior and interior | exterior and interior |
| Days after binding within which that inspection is ordered (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days after the inspection completion date allowed to cure a condition finding (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 45 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| New business period: days after the first effective date during which the policy may be cancelled for any underwriting reason (calendar days) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

## Applying the standards — hypothetical applications

The applicants below are hypothetical.

| Hypothetical applicant | Package sought | Gate result |
|---|---|---|
| Owner-occupant, roof 21 years old, dwelling 95 years old, no claims | HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | not accepted: roof age 21 exceeds 20 |
| Same applicant | HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | roof age 21 within 22 and dwelling age 95 within 120; accepted on these two conditions |
| Owner-occupant, one non-weather paid claim in the last 36 months | HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | not accepted: the package allows 0 |
| Same applicant | HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | the claims condition is met (1 allowed) |
| Dwelling not occupied by the owner | any package | not accepted: owner occupancy is required on every package |

A hypothetical HomeGuard HO-5 Signature policy has a new-business inspection of the exterior and the interior, ordered within 30 days after binding; a condition finding on it may be cured within 60 days after the inspection completion date.
